papers.authors: Jing‐Dong Feng, Ruo‐Meng Zhu, Yong Liu, Jun Zhang, Wang‐Kang Han, Qingqing Wang, Hui Qiao, Huan Pang, Zhi‐Guo Gu
papers.authorsCitation: J. Feng, R. Zhu, Y. Liu, J. Zhang, W. Han, Q. Wang, H. Qiao, H. Pang, Z. Gu
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Covalent organic frameworks (COFs) with abundant redox‐active sites are promising electrode materials for sodium‐ion batteries (SIBs). However, conventional design strategies are often limited by sluggish Na + transport and low utilization of active sites. Here, we report a pair of 3D COFs (COF‐O and COF‐H). In COF‐O, the C═O groups are precisely oriented toward the pore channels, allowing the O atoms to serve as effective Na + storage sites. In contrast, COF‐H contains only C–H groups within the pores, which lack Na + storage capability. When employed as an anode material in SIBs, COF‐O exhibits a high specific capacity of 318 mAh/g (1.9 times that of COF‐H) and excellent cycling stability over 6000 cycles. In situ spectroscopic studies combined with theoretical calculations reveal that the C═O groups in COF‐O act as efficient Na + storage sites, effectively enhancing the capacity and accelerating Na + transport kinetics. This work demonstrates that precisely orienting functional groups in 3D COFs can create effective ion transport channels, providing a promising strategy for designing advanced organic electrode materials for SIBs.

papers.title: Spatially Decoupled Ion Transport and Mechanical Robustness Enabled by a Molecular Scaffold Strap in Gel Polymer Electrolytes
papers.authors: Xin Shen, Chang Gao, Ke‐Feng Ren, Yun‐Fei Du, Zi‐Yi Wang, Feng Jiang, Zhao‐Yu Qu, Jia‐Xing Guo, He Liu, Rui Zhang, Yuping Wu, Xin‐Bing Cheng
papers.authorsCitation: X. Shen, C. Gao, K. Ren, Y. Du, Z. Wang, F. Jiang, Z. Qu, J. Guo, H. Liu, R. Zhang, Y. Wu, X. Cheng
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT In situ gel polymer electrolytes (GPEs), which confine liquid electrolytes within a polymer matrix, are promising for realizing high‐safety lithium (Li) metal batteries. However, the liquid phase and the polymer matrix act as reciprocal chokes: the liquid expedites ion transport but plasticizes the matrix and compromises its mechanical strength, whereas the matrix provides rigidity yet obstructs ionic conduction. In this study, we propose a molecular scaffold strap strategy that decouples the regulation of mechanical robustness and ion transport in GPEs. Specifically, six‐arm monomers are employed to form a 3D polymer matrix, while ethylene glycol dibutyl ether, with a size‐matched anchoring character, acts as a scaffold strap that strengthens adjacent polymer segments. Fluorinated carbonate cosolvents further facilitate Li + transport and interfacial stability. The engineered GPE exhibits a high modulus of 8.9 MPa, ionic conductivity of 3.82 × 10 −4 S cm −1 , Li + transference number of 0.68, and stable electrode interfaces. The Li||LiNi 0.8 Co 0.1 Mn 0.1 O 2 pouch cell (2.7 Ah) achieves 87% capacity retention after 100 cycles and exhibits an elevated self‐heating onset temperature of 160.7°C. Furthermore, a high energy density of 506 Wh kg −1 is demonstrated in the Cu||LiNi 0.92 Co 0.03 Mn 0.05 O 2 pouch cell (3.5 Ah).

papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Solid polymer electrolytes hold great promise for high‐energy‐density lithium metal batteries, yet their practical implementation is still hindered by sluggish room‐temperature Li + transport and insufficient high‐voltage tolerance ( i.e ., unstable above 4.3 V) especially when coupled with Ni‐rich layered cathodes. Herein, we report a cyano‐coordinating strategy to reconstruct the Li + solvation environment by precisely regulating the content of cyanoacrylate adhesive. This abandonment of ether‐oxygen polymers as the main material, that is, the competitive Li + –C≡N coordination reorganizes the primary solvation shell of Li + . This regulated solvation sheath simultaneously provides continuous low‐barrier hopping sites of Li + and improves the oxidative stability of the electrolytes. More importantly, the strong coordination anchoring between −C≡N and transition‐metal cations ( i.e ., TM δ+ –N≡C), suppresses irreversible dissolution of transition‐metal cations during cycling. The Li//NCM811 cells retain 88.2% of their initial capacity after 500 cycles at 4.3 V and 3 C and 80.1% after 350 cycles at 4.5 V and 1 C. Meanwhile, the cells exhibited a high operating voltage over 3.85 V, showing great potential for high‐energy‐density solid‐state batteries. This study establishes molecular coordination reconstruction to synergistically regulate the solvation behavior and high‐voltage interfacial chemistry of polymer electrolytes, providing a general design rationale for high‐energy‐density and long‐life solid‐state lithium‐metal batteries.

papers.authors: Yajie Hu, Jianxing Wang, Ting Li, Jinyu Tian, Ying Xu, Yifan Deng, Xin Zhang, Jie Hu, Zihan Chen, Miao He, Qi Liu, Zhenzhen Shen, Hao Shi, Jianping Long, Shimou Chen, Anjun Hu

papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Conventional linear polyether electrolytes feature abundant ether‐oxygen sites that dominate the primary Li + solvation shell, limiting anion participation and undermining ion transport and high‐voltage stability. A backbone‐mediated coordination‐environment reshaping strategy is proposed by incorporating diglycidyl 1,2‐cyclohexanedicarboxylate (DCD) into the copolymerization of 1,3‐dioxolane (DOL), yielding an in situ crosslinked gel polymer electrolyte, P(DCD‐DOL). The weakly coordinating ester carbonyl groups and the spatially restricted ether‐oxygen sites in the crosslinked network jointly weaken backbone–Li + coordination and promote anion/solvent participation in the Li + solvation shell. Multiscale characterizations and theoretical simulations confirm that P(DCD‐DOL) effectively optimizes the Li + solvation structure, leading to a high Li + transference number of 0.64, an oxidative stability window of 5.20 V, and inorganic‐rich electrode–electrolyte interphases. Consequently, Li||NCM811 cells with P(DCD‐DOL) retain 84.21% capacity after 500 cycles at 4.3 V, and 80.62% after 200 cycles at 4.5 V. Moreover, a 0.9 Ah pouch cell achieves an energy density of 305 Wh kg −1 and retains 82.33% capacity over 180 cycles. This work highlights polymer backbone engineering as an effective route to regulate Li + coordination and interfacial chemistry in high‐voltage lithium metal batteries.

为什么重要：该结果提示快充电极中的离子输运不仅可以通过增加缺陷数量改善，还可利用界面轨道耦合控制缺陷的空间类型及其动态响应，为构建高倍率、长寿命负极提供新路径。

papers.title: Na 2 Ti 3 O 7 ‐Assisted Grain‐Boundary Tailoring of NASICON Electrolytes for Room‐to‐Subzero‐Temperature All‐Solid‐State Sodium Metal Batteries
papers.authors: Hongyi Liao, Yang Yang, Huaguang Ma, Congcong Liu, Yu Yao, Xi Ke, Wubin Du, Zhijun Wu, Hongge Pan, Xianhong Rui, Yan Yu
papers.authorsCitation: H. Liao, Y. Yang, H. Ma, C. Liu, Y. Yao, X. Ke, W. Du, Z. Wu, H. Pan, X. Rui, Y. Yu
matchedTopics: Solid-state batteries
papers.summaryZh:
新在哪里：以界面黏附和Na+迁移势垒为双重准则筛选TiO2异相，并用Na2Ti3O7反应型烧结助剂原位生成TiO2衍生纳米晶，同时处理晶界传输、钠损失与陶瓷致密化。
性能：加入4 wt.% Na2Ti3O7后，NASICON电解质达到94.20%相对密度、1.65 mS cm−1室温离子电导率和0.27 eV活化能，并支持1.55 mA cm−2临界电流密度及超过1600 h的对称电池循环。
怎么解释：烧结过程中形成的TiO2衍生纳米晶重构晶界，伴随生成的含钠物种补偿钠挥发并促进致密化；理论计算表明所得异质界面兼具较强黏附和较低Na+迁移势垒。
为什么重要：该工作说明陶瓷固态电解质（solid-state electrolyte, SSE）的晶界优化不能只追求致密化，而应同步考虑界面结合和离子迁移，为反应型烧结助剂的理性选择提供了明确判据。

papers.title: Terminally Fluorinated Polyimide Interphase for Durable Lithium‐Rich Layered Oxide Cathodes
papers.authors: Chenghan Li, Juan Wang, Pei Zou, Haozhe Du, Shu Zhao, Shiqi Liu, Zhenlei Chen, Shaojuan Huang, Yuming Li, Yuqiang Li, Guoqing Wang, Zhenhui Bai, Jian Wang, Xianwei Guo, Zhengwei Wang, Xiao Feng, Haijun Yu
papers.authorsCitation: C. Li, J. Wang, P. Zou, H. Du, S. Zhao, S. Liu, Z. Chen, S. Huang, Y. Li, Y. Li, G. Wang, Z. Bai, J. Wang, X. Guo, Z. Wang, X. Feng, H. Yu
matchedTopics: Fast charging and interfacial ion transport
papers.summaryZh:
新在哪里：将含氟基团仅布置在聚酰亚胺链端，以提高界面电子势垒和抗氧化能力，同时避免主链氟化造成的Li+传输损失，针对富锂层状氧化物界面提出了位置选择性氟化策略。
性能：端基氟化聚酰亚胺包覆的富锂正极循环1000次后保持80.8%容量；Si/C||富锂正极软包电池达到409 Wh kg−1，并在100次循环后保持90.1%容量。
怎么解释：吸电子CF3端基抑制活性氧引发的聚合物降解、副反应和氧释放，高模量聚酰亚胺层同时限制应力诱导的颗粒开裂；摘要称其未明显牺牲Li+动力学，但未量化端基与主链效应的独立贡献。
为什么重要：结果表明界面聚合物的取代位置与取代基本身同样关键，可在化学稳定性、机械保护和离子传输之间取得更合理平衡，为高电压正极人工界面设计提供具体分子变量。

papers.title: Breaking Low-Temperature Bottlenecks via p–d–π-Type Local Environment toward High-Performance Polymer-Based All-Solid-State Lithium Battery
papers.authors: Tenghui Wang, Butian Chen, Tao Liu, Zecheng Fang, Yuehui Liu, Xinglong Jiang, Dewen Wang, Tianyu Zhu, Xiangfeng Liu
papers.authorsCitation: T. Wang, B. Chen, T. Liu, Z. Fang, Y. Liu, X. Jiang, D. Wang, T. Zhu, X. Liu
papers.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
matchedTopics: Solid-state batteries
papers.summaryZh:
新在哪里：在聚合物复合固态电解质中构建p–d–π型局域环境，将三锂盐形成的富阴离子缔合状态与镍酞菁提供的阳离子–π作用结合，同时调控体相Li+传输和电极界面反应。
性能：电解质在25、0和−40 °C下的离子电导率分别达到1.31、0.70和0.10 mS cm−1；LiFePO4全固态电池在0 °C循环500次后容量保持率为100%，并可在−37.8 °C运行。
怎么解释：FSI−、DFOB−和NFSA−的混合缔合削弱强离子缔合，镍酞菁的阳离子–π作用提供额外Li+迁移位点；离域π电子及Ni(3d)–O(2p)轨道杂化还被用于解释界面电荷转移和富LiF复合界面层的形成。
为什么重要：工作把低温聚合物固态电池的体相传输与双界面稳定性放在同一分子环境中设计，为同时改善低温电导率、高倍率性能和长期循环提供了较完整的材料策略。

papers.title: 4.8 V and All‐Climate (−60 to 55°C) All‐Solid‐State Batteries Enabled by Dual‐Phase Symbiotic Halide Solid Electrolytes
papers.authors: Zihan Xu, Ao Zeng, Kesheng Gao, Zhigang Zhang, Yoshihiro Kuroiwa, Sangwook Kim, Enyue Zhao, Xiaoling Xiao
papers.authorsCitation: Z. Xu, A. Zeng, K. Gao, Z. Zhang, Y. Kuroiwa, S. Kim, E. Zhao, X. Xiao
matchedTopics: Solid-state batteries
papers.summaryZh:
新在哪里：提出卤化物电解质的“双相共生”结构，用纳米晶LiAlCl4承担4.8 V高压稳定性，以无定形Li–M–O–Cl相提供低势垒、连续的Li+传输路径。
性能：同一电解质同时覆盖−60至55 °C和最高4.8 V：在−60 °C、4.8 V双重极端条件下仍达到109.6 mAh g−1，并维持1800 h稳定运行。
怎么解释：无定形相形成易贯通的离子传导网络，纳米晶区抵抗高电压诱导的结构和化学退化。摘要据此解释宽温高压兼容性，但未单独给出两相界面阻抗的贡献。
为什么重要：该结果说明高压稳定与低温电导不必完全依赖同一结构单元，可通过晶态–无定形相分工缓解固态电解质（solid-state electrolyte, SSE）的稳定性–传输权衡。

papers.title: Local Acidity as a Corrosiveness Descriptor of Fluorinated Ether Solvents in Lithium–Metal Batteries
papers.authors: Dongmin Park, Kyunam Lee, June Lee, Jisub Kim, Jihoon Oh, Insu Hwang, Sujin Kim, Inwoo Kim, Minkwan Kim, Ali Coskun, Jang Wook Choi

papers.summaryZh:
新在哪里：以位点局部酸度（local pKa）描述氟醚溶剂对锂金属的腐蚀性，替代仅根据最低未占分子轨道（lowest unoccupied molecular orbital, LUMO）判断还原稳定性的常见思路。
性能：提高氟化程度并非单调改善稳定性；中等氟化的F4MEP兼具富阴离子溶剂化结构和较低腐蚀性，而过度氟化反而增强对锂金属的化学侵蚀。
怎么解释：局部pKa表征特定位点受氟化诱导电子效应后的热力学反应倾向，可定量关联溶剂腐蚀性；F4MEP由此在弱化Li+–溶剂作用与避免过度活化之间取得平衡。
为什么重要：工作把“氟越多越稳定”的经验判断改写为可计算的位点反应性问题，为氟化电解液分子的氟化位置和程度提供了更具预测性的筛选参数。

papers.title: Void suppressive lithium anodes for all-solid-state batteries
papers.authors: Xiao Ji, Yijie Liu, Xinzi He, Singyuk Hou, Jijian Xu, Kimberly S. Reeves, Michael J. Zachman, Ji Chen, Tao Deng, Jiaxun Zhang, Miaofang Chi, Chunsheng Wang

为什么值得关注：锂负极孔洞会增加界面阻抗并导致局部电流集中，是全固态电池在有限压力下长期运行的重要限制；具体材料设计、数据和机制仅凭题名无法进一步判断。

papers.title: Unconventional Dendrite‐Free Deposition of Mg Metal Anodes at Low Temperatures
papers.authors: Yuan Wang, Shiyang Wang, Junbo Cui, Kangyu Yi, Kewei Wang, Ke Wang, Zixu He, Yijiang Bao, Junpeng Yan, Yulin Jie, Dongsheng Xu, Xuefeng Wang, Ruiguo Cao, Shuhong Jiao

matchedTopics: Fast charging and interfacial ion transport
papers.summaryZh:
新在哪里：揭示Mg金属与Li、Na、Zn不同的反常温度效应：降低温度没有加剧枝晶，反而形成更均匀、无枝晶的Mg沉积，并进一步关联到低温固态电解质界面膜（solid–electrolyte interphase, SEI）的组成与厚度。
性能：−20 °C形成约2–3 nm、富高模量无机组分的超薄SEI，Mg负极平均库仑效率达到99.92%，并可稳定循环2000次。
怎么解释：低温改变界面副反应路径，形成更薄且机械强度更高的无机SEI，从而均化Mg沉积。冷冻透射电镜、原子力显微镜和光电子能谱提供了形貌与成分证据，但摘要未建立定量因果关系。
为什么重要：该结果表明不同金属负极不能套用统一的低温沉积图景，并为Mg电池的低温界面设计提供了一个反常但可利用的机制线索。

papers.title: Synergistic Molecular and Polymer Network Design Enables Stable LiPF 6 ‐Based Gel Polymer Electrolytes for Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.authors: Min Wang, Mengjie Li, Junru Wu, Yuefeng Meng, Lili Lin, Yadong Wang, Hao Du, Xinran Geng, Zhiqiang Fu, Cuiping Han, Baohua Li

matchedTopics: Lithium-metal and anode-free batteries
papers.summaryZh:
新在哪里：将溶剂化调节与含氟聚合物网络限域结合，通过网络对PF6−的强作用抑制PF5生成，从源头切断LiPF6–PF5诱导FEC脱氟和HF形成的连续降解路径。
性能：该凝胶聚合物电解质（gel polymer electrolyte, GPE）使Li||LiCoO2电池在4.5 V循环400次后保持82.6%容量；1.3 Ah软包电池在N/P=1.1条件下循环30次后保持80.7%容量。
怎么解释：四氟乙氧基苯调节Li+溶剂化并促进稳定正极界面，原位聚合的含氟芳香网络结合PF6−、减少Lewis酸性PF5，最终使两极界面偏向形成致密富LiF层。
为什么重要：工作将LiPF6/FEC体系的失效具体定位到PF5介导的化学链条，并展示了如何用分子添加剂和网络功能分工进行阻断，对高电压凝胶电解质设计具有明确启示。

papers.title: Synchronous Interfacial Chemistry via a Fluorine‐Free Bifunctional Additive for Ultrastable Aqueous Zinc‐Iodine Batteries
papers.authors: Jiatong Li, Jian Qin, Minhao Dai, Yi Chen, Wei Xiao, Wenbin Li, Jingjing Wang, Xifei Li
papers.authorsCitation: J. Li, J. Qin, M. Dai, Y. Chen, W. Xiao, W. Li, J. Wang, X. Li
matchedTopics: Fast charging and interfacial ion transport
papers.summaryZh:
新在哪里：用无氟双功能小分子麦芽酚在共享电解液中同步调控锌负极和碘正极，避免传统策略分别修饰两极却忽略物种跨界面迁移的问题。
性能：I−正极液体系循环超过35000次，单圈容量衰减0.0007%；固载碘体系在约2 mAh cm−2下循环11000次后仍保持83.8%容量，0.54 Ah软包电池累计输出超过250 Ah。
怎么解释：麦芽酚在锌表面协同平面吸附并重构内亥姆霍兹层（inner Helmholtz plane, IHP），抑制水/硫酸根副反应并调节成核；其多齿氧位点同时锚定并削弱I3−，限制穿梭并促进I2/I−转化。
为什么重要：该工作说明双电极失效可以通过同一电解液分子的界面选择性作用协同处理，为减少含氟添加剂、构建长寿命锌–碘电池提供了较完整的分子设计范式。

papers.title: Non‐Entangled Chains Enable Rapid Na + Transport Through Ion‐Traps in Gel Polymer Electrolytes at Low Temperatures
papers.authors: Cheng Huang, Xiaochuan Duan, Xinnan Zhang, Jianing Li, Rou Tan, Yulin Bai, Dongzheng Wu, Shaohui Guo, Jianmin Ma, Zhong Li, Xian‐Ming Zhang
papers.authorsCitation: C. Huang, X. Duan, X. Zhang, J. Li, R. Tan, Y. Bai, D. Wu, S. Guo, J. Ma, Z. Li, X. Zhang
matchedTopics: Ion-conducting polymers and single-ion conductors
papers.summaryZh:
新在哪里：将低温凝胶聚合物电解质中的链缠结明确为“离子陷阱”来源，并以非缠结聚1,3-二氧戊环构建连续、均一的Na+配位环境，而不是单纯通过增加液相含量提高电导率。
性能：非缠结网络使Na+迁移数达到0.85，在−50 °C仍具有0.25 mS cm−1离子电导率；Na||Na3V2(PO4)3全电池在−40 °C下容量保持率接近100%。
怎么解释：减少链缠结可缩短链松弛时间、增加自由体积并降低离子陷阱密度，同时促进NaTFSI解离和连续Na+扩散；更均匀的Na+通量进一步对应更薄、更均一的SEI。
为什么重要：工作把低温传输瓶颈从笼统的链段运动不足细化为可由拓扑结构调节的离子陷阱，为在不依赖大量增塑剂的情况下设计低温聚合物电解质提供了新路径。

papers.title: Engineering the Interfacial Microenvironment of Fe–N–C Cathode to Boost Proton Conduction for High-Performance Fuel Cells
papers.authors: Jinjing Tao, Yongjin Ruan, Yusheng Liu, Pengbo Wang, Ming Yang, Changpeng Liu, Xiaozheng Duan, Minhua Shao, Jianbing Zhu, Meiling Xiao, Wei Xing
papers.authorsCitation: J. Tao, Y. Ruan, Y. Liu, P. Wang, M. Yang, C. Liu, X. Duan, M. Shao, J. Zhu, M. Xiao, W. Xing
papers.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
matchedTopics: Fast charging and interfacial ion transport
papers.summaryZh:
新在哪里：通过碳纳米管（carbon nanotubes, CNTs）表面含氧基团与离聚物侧链的非共价作用，重构Fe–N–C阴极的催化剂–离聚物–反应物三相界面，把质子传输作为阴极层的直接设计变量。
性能：与常规结构相比，阴极层质子电导率提高2.3倍；质子交换膜燃料电池（proton-exchange membrane fuel cell, PEMFC）峰值功率密度达到1.63 W cm⁻²，在0.9 V（iR校正）时电流密度为53 mA cm⁻²。
怎么解释：含氧界面促进水富集并增强水分子间作用，形成连续氢键水网络；粗粒化分子动力学模拟支持该网络有利于长程质子跳跃。该机制由模拟与电导率变化共同支持，但摘要未给出区分不同含氧基团贡献的对照。
为什么重要：结果表明，非铂氧还原催化剂（oxygen reduction reaction, ORR）的器件性能不仅取决于活性位点，还受催化层内质子输运限制；界面微环境可成为连接催化剂结构与膜电极性能的设计层级。

papers.title: Enabling Fast Charging of Lithium‐Ion Batteries With Regioisomeric Nitrile Additives for Interphase Regulation
papers.authors: Chen Liu, Zehao Cui, Arumugam Manthiram
papers.authorsCitation: C. Liu, Z. Cui, A. Manthiram
matchedTopics: Fast charging and interfacial ion transport
papers.summaryZh:
新在哪里：以仅0.5 wt.%的区域异构腈类添加剂3-(三氟甲基)苯甲腈调控正、负极电解质界面，同时保持与商业LP57电解液兼容。
性能：在1 Ah石墨||NCM811软包电池中实现更好的快充表现，并改善低温、高温和高电压稳定性；摘要未给出软包快充循环的具体倍率与保持率。
怎么解释：添加剂在负极优先还原，形成约10 nm的受控固体电解质界面膜（solid electrolyte interphase, SEI），而LP57形成约450 nm的富锂层；在正极侧则形成更薄、更均匀的正极电解质界面膜（cathode electrolyte interphase, CEI）。弛豫时间分布（distribution of relaxation times, DRT）分析显示界面阻抗降低，并伴随锂沉积受抑。
为什么重要：该工作把添加剂的区域异构结构与双界面成膜差异联系起来，为不更换主体电解液条件下改善快充提供了较接近产业配方的路径。

papers.title: Data-Driven Design of Asymmetric, Fluorine-Free Ethers for High-Voltage Lithium-Metal Batteries under Extreme Conditions
papers.authors: Hanjun Li, Yecheng Leng, Wanbao Wu, Tingting Wu, Yuchen Yang, Xuyang Zhang, Chaowei Li, Mingjin Cui, Xinghai Ning, Xi Zhu, Yu Zhao, Haoshen Zhou, Yu Ding
papers.authorsCitation: H. Li, Y. Leng, W. Wu, T. Wu, Y. Yang, X. Zhang, C. Li, M. Cui, X. Ning, X. Zhu, Y. Zhao, H. Zhou, Y. Ding
papers.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
matchedTopics: Lithium-metal and anode-free batteries
papers.summaryZh:
新在哪里：将数据驱动筛选与分子设计结合，从千余种候选物中提出不对称、无氟醚溶剂，通过醚链长度和配位氧电子不等价同时调节高电压稳定性、挥发性与去溶剂化动力学。
性能：Li||LiCoO₂电池在−40 °C保留室温容量的81.2%，循环300次后容量保持率为91.3%；1 Ah软包电池在−35 °C保留71.9%容量，5 Ah软包电池在1 g Ah⁻¹贫液条件下达到475 Wh kg⁻¹。
怎么解释：较长醚链通过多齿配位提高抗氧化与抗挥发能力；分子不对称性使不同配位氧具有不等价结合强度，在保持多齿配位热力学稳定性的同时，由较弱位点降低去溶剂化的动力学约束。该解释由计算和实验共同支持，但摘要未说明各描述符的独立贡献。
为什么重要：结果说明无氟并不必然以牺牲高电压或低温性能为代价，并给出可被继续检验的结构变量，而不是仅依赖经验性含氟化设计。

papers.title: An Ultrafast-Charging Daniell-Type All-Solid-State Battery
papers.authors: Tao Yu, Haoyu Li, Zhu Cheng, Zhaoguo Liu, Daxian Zuo, Sheng Xu, Bo Peng, Ruilin Hou, Yuan Rao, Shaohua Guo, Marnix Wagemaker, Haoshen Zhou

papers.title: Tailoring Energy Landscapes for Vehicular Transport in Single-Ion Conducting Organo-Ionic Solids
